reports.remark: Water up to the headlights of cars off bowie road east of route 1. Road closed.
The USGS stream gauge on east branch herbert run exceeded its flood stage of 7 feet. The stream was out of its banks and covering yards near the stream.
Dorsey road flooded and closed at sawmill creek between central avenue and route 648.
Fields and trails were flooded near the little patuxent river.
Water more than halfway up the wheels of cars in parking lots near linthicum heights.
Aviation boulevard reported to be flooded and completely closed at the road leading to the MARC and Amtrak station.
All lanes of route 3 flooded by sawmill creek and closed near furnace branch road.
Flooding reported at the maintenance shop at BWI.
Water flowing over roadways and up to the headlights of cars near BWI airport.
Water flowing over roadways. Damage to up to 100 vehicles in long term parking lots a and b at BWI airport.
Water flowing over roadways. Water also up to the headlights of cars in parking lots near BWI airport.
Gwynns falls exceeded its flood stage of 13 feet...with minor overbank flooding occurring for about an hour near the gwynns falls trail.

The stream gauge on sawmill creek exceeded its flood stage of 5 feet. Numerous roads were closed and flooding was reported in two businesses. This is the highest creek level ever recorded at this location. Continuous records date back to 1983.
Outer loop of the baltimore beltway flooded and completely closed at quarantine road. All traffic diverted.
Maryland 295 flooded and closed between the baltimore beltway and westport.
Baltimore harbor tunnel closed due to flooding.
At least six inches of water flowing across benson avenue in arbutus.
Baltimore annapolis boulevard was flooded and closed at the magothy river crossing near pasadena.
